pandas.DataFrame.rename_axis

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Change the name of an axis while preserving its labels.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

  • Returns

Call syntax

DataFrame.rename_axis(mapper=…, *, index=…, columns=…, axis=0, copy=…, inplace=…)
